WITH account_data AS (
    SELECT 
        a.acct_ref,
        p."PLT_KIND",
        -- CMS = 0.4 * (1 - content_uniqueness) + 0.3 * media_reuse_rate + 0.3 * (1 - TxtUniq)
        0.4 * (1 - (cm->'content_quality'->>'content_uniqueness')::real) 
          + 0.3 * (cm->'link_media'->>'media_reuse_rate')::real 
          + 0.3 * (1 - im."TxtUniq") as cms,
        -- MPS = 0.3 * abuse_count / 1000 + 0.4 * impact_score + 0.3 * risk_value
        0.3 * ((rp->'violation_history'->>'abuse_count')::real / 1000.0) 
          + 0.4 * (rp->'risk_scores'->>'impact_score')::real 
          + 0.3 * (rp->'risk_scores'->>'risk_value')::real as mps,
        -- NIC = 0.4 * ConnQual + 0.3 * NetInfl + 0.3 * IntDiv
        0.4 * nm.ConnQual 
          + 0.3 * ca.NetInfl 
          + 0.3 * nm.IntDiv as nic
    FROM accounts a
    JOIN content_activity cm ON cm.acct_slot = a.acct_ref
    JOIN interaction_metrics im ON im.acct_dm = a.acct_ref
    JOIN risk_and_moderation rp ON rp.acct_risk = a.acct_ref
    JOIN network_metrics nm ON nm.acct_node = a.acct_ref
    JOIN platforms p ON p."PLT_CODE" = a.plt_key
    JOIN account_clusters ac ON ac.acct_bridge = a.acct_ref
    JOIN cluster_analysis ca ON ca."CLSTR_PIN" = ac.clu_ref
)
SELECT "PLT_KIND", AVG(cms * mps * nic) as avg_damage_potential
FROM account_data
GROUP BY "PLT_KIND"
ORDER BY avg_damage_potential DESC;
